caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure standing and facing forward. The figure is wearing a white ruffled bonnet on the head and has brown hair showing at the sides. The face is colored in a pale tone with red cheeks, red lips, and prominent facial features. The upper body is covered by a multicolored paisley-patterned garment featuring shades of yellow, red, and light purple, covered by a white apron that extends from the upper chest to below the waist. Over the shoulders, there is a red and white shawl draped loosely. The lower part of the figure wears a purple skirt with horizontal stripes in red, blue, and purple hues near the hem. The legs are covered in light blue stockings, and the figure wears black shoes with low heels. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist's name "HILDA OLSON" is written in small capital letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Marionette - "Biddy"
